title: Silly and Purry!
description: My lil resource pack that I have made mostly for mini games (bedwars, skywars). Changes HUD, some items, effects and more :3
body:
## What is "Silly and Purry"?
It is little themed resource pack "Silly and Purry!", that changes some sprites in game to something silly or goofy and fancy at the same time (atleast I think so:D). It was made mostly for mini games (such as bed wars or sky wars), but it is also suitable for survival game. 





### **!!!THAT IS NOT FINAL VERSION!!!** 
I am gonna make more updates soon!





### Current addings (changes): 
> new crosshair (good for bows)

> HUD sprites (rather all)

> new golden apple sprite (turned into fih c:)

> critical damage particle sprite changed

> all common weapons and instuments (sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe)
![swords and tools! ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50537743f5bca2b0b5efce3da7409aa07e4b45fa.png)

> and some other textures! (for example scissors:D)



### Plans
In future I'm planning to change other weapons, effects, potions, maybe GUIs
